Research position overview

ISTA's PhD programme recruits across research groups in the natural and mathematical sciences. Admitted researchers receive funded doctoral training and work towards a research project within the institute. The new application cycle is expected to open in late October 2026.

Research Areas

  • Natural sciences
  • Mathematics
  • Interdisciplinary research

Stipend / salarySalaried doctoral employment; exact amount not stated

CriterionRequirement

Further conditionsAll admitted doctoral researchers receive funding; science and mathematics disciplines.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens late October 2026
Deadline / consideration round8 January 2027, 15:00 CET
LocationAustria

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

About Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

ISTA is a research institute in Austria dedicated to basic research and graduate education in the natural and mathematical sciences. Its doctoral programme recruits across research groups and provides funded research training.
